name: Gmail
description: Read, send, search, and organize emails via Gmail
author: flock

anyOf.description: Full Gmail experience via browser session — rich compose, CC/BCC, attachments, formatting
anyOf.rationale: Uses your existing Google login — no app passwords or extra setup needed.

anyOf.description: Direct email access via IMAP with app password
anyOf.setupInstructions: Use a Google App Password for IMAP access — not your normal Google password. Go to myaccount.google.com/apppasswords to generate one.
